data.name: Berserk Fury Gift
data.description: You can voluntarily enter an enraged state as a free action for %1 rounds per day; these rounds don't have to be consecutive. Once you end this state, you can't enter it again for 1 minute. While enraged, you gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls, %1 temporary hit points, and a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves. You are in control of yourself during this rage, but you must still succeed at a Will save to resist losing control (as detailed in this manifestation's stain). While voluntarily enraged, you take a -2 penalty on Will saves.|PrometheanManifestationLevel|TL
